prompt: Use $spec-dev to change the order API status field. The request does not say whether old clients must remain compatible or whether the old field can be removed immediately.

expectedInvariants.statement: The agent identifies backward compatibility as a decision outside ordinary implementation authority.
The agent asks only for the decision needed to resolve externally observable behavior.
The agent does not freeze a technical design before the compatibility decision is accepted.

prohibitedBehaviors.statement: Silently removes the old public field.
Asks the user to choose unrelated code-level details.
Treats a speculative compatibility assumption as accepted intent.
